name: vibe-visual-forge
description: Mobile/desktop PWA and deployed HTTPS Streamable HTTP MCP tools for real HTML, procedural 3D GLB and UI QA.

interface.longDescription: Mobile and desktop PWA, with a remote HTTPS MCP for design specifications, working standalone HTML templates, low-poly 3D scene plans and contrast checks. Public cloud MCP does not access user files or perform autonomous 24/7 jobs.
defaultPrompt: Create a production UI from my screenshots, render it and compare visual fidelity.
Create a game-ready 3D environment with materials, LOD and scene QA.
Inspect my project, find visual defects and fix them rather than showing a mockup.
